title_en: Amending Act to Industrial Competitiveness Enhancement Act (Law No. 70 of 2021)
title_ja: 産業競争力強化法等の一部を改正する等の法律
summary_en: The e-Gov law update list shows an entry for the Act Partially Amending the Industrial Competitiveness Enhancement Act and Other Acts (Reiwa 3 Act No. 70), which amends the Act on Strengthening Management of Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises (Heisei 11 Act No. 18). The metadata gives a promulgation date of 2021-06-16 and an enforcement date of 2021-06-16, while the update list date is shown as 2026-09-08.
business_impact_en: Businesses subject to the Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises management strengthening framework may wish to check whether the amended provisions affect them. The specific content and scope of the amendments cannot be determined from the provided metadata.
recommended_action_en: Review the official Japanese text on e-Gov to confirm which provisions were amended, their effective dates, and any applicability to your operations.
source_name: e-Gov Law Search (法令更新一覧)
summary_ja: e-Gov法令検索の更新一覧により、「産業競争力強化法等の一部を改正する等の法律」（令和三年法律第七十号）が公表されています。対象法令は中小企業等経営強化法（平成十一年法律第十八号）であり、原文には公布日および施行日がいずれも2021年6月16日と記載されています。更新一覧日は2026年9月8日とされています。
business_impact_ja: 中小企業等経営強化法の改正内容によっては、関連する経営強化に関する制度対応や社内手続の見直しが必要となる可能性があります。自社が対象となる範囲は、改正の具体的な内容次第で異なると考えられます。
recommended_action_ja: 改正の具体的な内容および施行状況については、e-Gov法令検索等の日本語の公式情報源で最新の条文をご確認いただくことをお勧めします。
ai_notes: Based only on title and metadata; the substance of the amendments is not provided. The enforcement date shown (2021-06-16) may apply only to some provisions, and the 2026-09-08 update list date appears to be a listing date rather than an amendment date. Preliminary labels (Other / In Force / Medium) are keyword-based and unverified.

title_en: Act Partially Amending the Industrial Competitiveness Enhancement Act and Related Laws
title_ja: 産業競争力強化法等の一部を改正する等の法律
summary_en: This item concerns an amending act (Reiwa 3 Act No. 70) that partially revises the Industrial Competitiveness Enhancement Act and related laws, with the affected law listed as the Act on Strengthening the Management of Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (Heisei 11 Act No. 18). According to the metadata, the amending act carries a promulgation date of 2021-06-16 and a stated enforcement date of 2021-08-02. The record appears in the e-Gov Law Search law-update listing.
business_impact_en: Businesses, particularly small and medium-sized enterprises, may be affected by changes to management-strengthening and industrial competitiveness rules, so the amendments could have operational or compliance relevance.
recommended_action_en: Consider reviewing the official Japanese source on e-Gov Law Search to confirm the amendment's scope, enforcement date, and applicability.
source_name: e-Gov Law Search (法令更新一覧)
ai_notes: Based only on the provided Japanese title and metadata; the enforcement date shown (2021-08-02) comes from the item data and should be verified against the official source. Preliminary triage labels are not authoritative.
summary_ja: e-Gov法令検索の更新一覧に、中小企業等経営強化法（平成十一年法律第十八号）を対象とする改正が掲載されています。改正法令は「産業競争力強化法等の一部を改正する等の法律」（令和三年法律第七十号）で、公布日は2021年6月16日、施行日は2021年8月2日とされています。
business_impact_ja: 中小企業等経営強化法に関連する事業運営や社内対応に影響が及ぶ可能性があります。改正内容の具体的範囲によっては、関係規程の見直しが必要となることも考えられます。
